candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 2017 - 25cm (retired)
verified_facts: The 25cm 2017 composite is retired and no longer available on the Data Services Platform.
EA states it was replaced by a 1m resolution composite product.
The retired product used terrain-only processing and declared +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: Finer nominal pixel size in a retired composite does not make it a more current or automatically more accurate parcel-height source than the current primary contract.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return Digital Surface Model (FZ_DSM) - 2m
verified_facts: The product covers about 99% of England at 2m resolution.
It uses the first or only laser return and includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain where the first return is ground.
National LIDAR Programme surveys are merged with feathering across overlaps and metadata catalogues identify the contributing survey.
semantic_limits: First-return 2m surface heights are not bare-earth ground heights and cannot replace the 1m DTM primary samples.
